title: Categorical trace is invariant under an intertwining isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a braided monoidal category with unit $\mathbf 1$, and let $P,Q\in\mathcal C$ each have a chosen right dual, with categorical trace defined by evaluation, braiding and coevaluation as in [sk-d-trace]. Let $u:P\to P$, $v:Q\to Q$, and $a:P\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ satisfy $a\circ u=v\circ a$. Then $\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal C}(u)=\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal C}(v)$ in $\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal C}(\mathbf 1)$.
